Score. Entry: chat messages to LongwindBot port 7008, no auth. Docker publishes on 127.0.0.1, but default documented deployment binds loopback... AV: network (reachable across network in Docker with published ports on loopback; attack from same machine). Documented default deployment publishes on 127.0.0.1 — attacker needs local access or a local user? CVSS AV: with loopback binding, remote attacker cannot reach; but a web page in operator's browser can (CORS *). Still, AV per rubric: it's a network service; the port is reachable via localhost. I'd say AV:N (network-reachable via HTTP), noting localhost-only default; but rubric says apply FIRST definitions to bind address. Binding 127.0.0.1 means remote network exploit blocked → AV:L? Many would score AV:L for loopback-bound. But CORS * and README says "anything that can reach those ports can drive the agents" — with default 127.0.0.1, attacker on same machine. I'll use AV:L. Hmm, but the attack is via chat HTTP; attacker needs local access. Score AV:L.

AC:L, AT:N (context overflow enabled), PR:N, UI:N. VC:H (API key, admin password — specific high-value info), VI:N/... attacker only reads; VI:N, VA:N. Subsequent systems: none affected → SC:N/SI:N/SA:N. Actually disclosure of credentials could enable later attacks but impact here is confidentiality of vulnerable system H.

AIVSS: LC=D (direct user message to privileged output path). CP: attacker context persists? LongwindBot chat doesn't persist memory (memory store is MemoryBot). Session-only... attack uses multiple messages in a session but no durable store; CP=S? Testing confirms unreachable after session — no store for longwindbot. Context persists only within session → CP=S. Actually evidence: memoryStore is in-memory per agent, but is it for longwindbot? It's MemoryBot injection. For this path, attacker-controlled context is within the session conversation → S? "ephemeral session state... testing confirms unreachable after session boundary" — not confirmed. CP=N? Single-turn/stateless. The extraction is multi-turn but no carryover store. I'll say CP=S (multi-turn session context). Hmm safer: CP=S.

AP: C? LongwindBot only has search/calculator tools; effect confined to its own reply → AP=N. RH: reachable proxy? The success criteria pattern / grader checks the reply; is the evaluator within agent's reach? The agent could produce text matching the pattern — the scoring regex is in challenges; agent can't tamper with the grader, but it can emit the answer content. Verifier channel (response text) is reachable → reachable_proxy=true, verified_episodes=0 → P. locus=evaluator? RH locus required for P/D — locus evaluator? The reward channel is the success pattern in the reply — that's evaluator. Set reachable_proxy=true, isolation_verified=null, verified_episodes=0, episodes_reviewed=0, locus "evaluator".

ES: tools search, calculator — fixed allowlist, no dynamic extension on path → ES=N? LongwindBot path doesn't call tools. ES=N.

Automatable: Yes (scriptable chat). Technical impact: Partial (disclosure only). Applicability: default simulated mode, no LLM — scripted response; model-directed goal pursuit? As implemented: no (canned responses, no model) → false/false. As modeled (LLM mode documented): model directs responses, selects... tools not passed to model → selects_or_sequences_actions false, model_directed_goal_pursuit true (as modeled). Confidence medium.

CVSS vector: AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N.
